title: Clearing powers of ℓ from morphisms between integral constructible scalar extensions
statement: For prime ℓ, a finite normed extension E of ℚ_ℓ and a scheme X with Noetherian underlying space, let A and B be integral bounded constructible complexes, with actual scalar extension F from def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients. Every morphism f:F(A)→F(B) satisfies ℓ^n f=F(g) for an integer n≥0 and an integral morphism g:A→B.

proof.text: Tensor the coefficient telescope lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficient-telescope with a complex K representing B. Tensor preserves its colimit. Prove extension followed by restriction is naturally isomorphic to tensor with the restricted rational regular module, and that the normalized zeroth leg is the extension-restriction adjunction unit. Every stage is isomorphic to K.

Localize the exact adjunction along the complex-to-derived-category functor Q and prove its unit equation under the canonical factorization isomorphisms. Transport the complex telescope and its leg equations to the derived category.
Boundedness of B gives the same cohomological lower bound for all telescope stages. Apply lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-sequential-hom to the adjoint of f to factor it through stage n.

Multiplying by ℓ^n takes the nth leg to the zeroth leg. Naturality of the adjunction unit and injectivity of its Hom bijection identify the multiplied rational map with the extension of an integral map. Transport along Q(K)≅B and the canonical isomorphism between the left derived functor and the exact induced derived functor.

proof_origin.note: A4 stage-3 reduction; coefficient telescope and denominator calculation are proved, sequential Hom continuity is the remaining geometric input.
